exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Cleft sentences — it is… that…

items.prompt: ___ the close of the meeting ___ decides whether anything was actually agreed.
items.hintAfterError: Cleft sentence: 'It + be' abre a frase e o pronome relativo liga a parte enfatizada ao resto.

items.prompt: What really matters ___ who owns the decision.
items.hintAfterError: A oração com 'What' funciona como sujeito singular.
Passado: 'It' + verbo 'be' no passado; para pessoa, o relativo pode ser 'who'.

items.prompt: ___ the trading desk needs is a clear action list.
___ facilitation, not charisma, ___ makes the meeting productive.
